verdicts.reason: Both layouts are the same: the tagline sits far from the headline, under the phone, and the two badges are split off below the CTA with big gaps. That makes them float as loose fragments and puts them out of the original's order. The headline is left-aligned while the SOLSTICE brand line is centred. B is worse because its headline wraps to three lines and leaves 'back' alone as an orphan, with dead space after it. A keeps the cleaner two-line headline that fills the width, though its side margins are tight.
